<!-- pr-reviewer: a3d7315e34c1c72972085f8fbe593d06b68b0f7b -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge. Set `merge-ready` because the review is clean and the PR is MERGEABLE.

Checked the full diff against current upstream `AGENTS.md` at `ddee3aed6064eefe157110ab8923dbb02e1591ca`.

- The warning counts commits that the local branch lacks. It checks both remote refs without a fetch.
- The gate keeps the requested base and its existing plan. Missing refs do not stop the gate.
- The decision record explains the choice and the rejected options.
- The body has `Process change: yes`. The PR does not change `PROCESS_VERSION`.

Local build and tests:

- Worktree: `.claude/worktrees/review-3954`. The trial merge with upstream/main reports `Already up to date.`
- The PR directly follows this upstream base. HEAD is the full PR head above; no merge commit exists, so HEAD^1 is the base.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: selected the xtask test step.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed. One step, 383 tests passed, zero failed, zero stalled.
- Both `stale_base_tests` pins passed. The unit suite passed 336 tests. The integration suites passed 47 tests.
- `RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- The clippy error reported in the PR body did not occur here.

Extra suites run: none outside the quick plan. The diff changes no fixtures, importers, posts, operations, motion, or catalog files.

Mutations: not run. This change is outside the safety tier. No code was changed during this review.

Goldens moved: none. No recorded programs changed. No UI screenshot requirement applies.

Light lane: inspected with `cargo xtask gate light --dry-run`; tests were not run. It selects unchanged motion and app code. This review built only xtask, the touched crate. Full heavy lanes were not run.

Requested before merge: none.

The worktree and branch remain in place for the next review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
Left for the maintainer: process file (`xtask/`). No merge by the sweep.
